gloss_en: Shabbat, the seventh-day Sabbath (the holy day of rest, שַׁבָּת) — which testifies to God's unity and the creation of the world, and serves in Likutey Moharan as the aspect (bechina) of faith, truth, teshuvah, the World to Come, da'at, the inner point, the luminaries of light, and the Name of the Holy One
